nodes.text: coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Workbook writer — sole writer of Inventory_Lifecycle_Report.xlsx. Create it exactly once with exactly four sheets: Product_Inventory with columns product_name, category, price, stock_qty, stock_status, total_sales, days_of_supply and all 82 rows sorted by days_of_supply ascending; Reorder_Alerts with columns product_name, current_stock, reorder_point, urgency and only Critical/Out_of_Stock rows, Out_of_Stock first; Category_Summary with columns category, product_count, avg_stock, total_value, one row per category; Restock_Schedule with columns product_name, reorder_date, quantity, supplier and the frozen March 10, 2026 rows. Write literal values only, read all four populated ranges back, and return path, sheet order, row counts and equality controls.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): External-services writer — sole owner of the three external outputs. Fully paginate the exact-title search for cloud spreadsheet Inventory Dashboard, create/reuse at most once, block duplicate titles/tabs, own exactly one Category_Summary tab, batch-write the frozen category rows and read them back; search the exact Inventory Restock Review Meeting on 2026-03-11 10:00-11:00 America/New_York, create at most once with the frozen critical-item count in the description, and get_event; paginate Sent search/read candidates for purchasing@company.com and exact subject Critical Inventory Alert - Restock Required, send at most once with the frozen out-of-stock/critical counts and the top three complete item names, then read it back.
